answer: Agents can gate valuable actions behind a refundable stake locked in a vault, with each account’s stake capped by an independently verified scarce resource such as a unique human credential. When a participant submits a fraud proof showing that an agent double-spent or broke a signed commitment, a deterministic rule slashes its stake and pays part to the challenger. A haven for honest newcomers can offer low-risk tasks first, while a private whisper channel coordinates challenges; neither grants identities for free. Sybils therefore require costly credentials and capital, both exposed to loss.
